## ExecutableTrustStatus interface

Trust status of an executable, as recorded in the trust-on-first-use (TOFU) trust manifest.

Returned by [VaultKeeper.approveExecutable()](./vaultkeeper.vaultkeeper.approveexecutable.md) and [VaultKeeper.checkExecutableTrust()](./vaultkeeper.vaultkeeper.checkexecutabletrust.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ExecutableTrustStatus 
```

Hashes recorded as approved for this executable in the trust manifest, in approval order (empty when the executable has never been approved). When [ExecutableTrustStatus.hashMismatch](./vaultkeeper.executabletruststatus.hashmismatch.md) is `true`<!-- -->, these are the prior approved values that [ExecutableTrustStatus.hash](./vaultkeeper.executabletruststatus.hash.md) no longer matches; the last element is the most recently approved hash.

`true` when the executable is already known to the manifest but its current hash does not match any approved value — a TOFU conflict. A conflicting executable is never trusted; callers must re-approve or deny.
